project.name: YiPet
project.description: A customized fork of Dark Reader — a Manifest V2/V3 browser extension that dynamically applies a dark theme to any website. Service-worker-driven background, content-script-driven inject layer, and Malevic-rendered UI surfaces (popup, options, devtools, stylesheet-editor).

tour.title: Service worker boots
tour.description: src/background/index.ts constructs the Extension class — wires tab, alarm, and command listeners; loads user storage.

tour.title: Content script injects
tour.description: On document_start, src/inject/index.ts calls createDarkReaderInstance, which subscribes to style-scope changes and applies dynamic-theme / SVG-filter / stylesheet overlay.

tour.title: Generators transform colors
tour.description: src/inject/dynamic-theme invokes src/generators/dynamic-theme.ts + utils/modify-colors.ts to produce per-element CSS modifications.

tour.title: User changes settings
tour.description: src/ui/popup uses a Connector to the background; user toggles flow back through user-storage.ts which persists to chrome.storage.

tour.title: Sites opt in via API
tour.description: Third-party pages call the public API (src/api/index.ts → src/api/chrome.ts and src/api/fetch.ts) to programmatically toggle or set theme parameters.
